answer: Agents may wander between forge inspection jobs, but each paid epoch seat needs a unique burn receipt. The burn commits to the agent key and epoch; a global spent set accepts it once, and the registry grants one seat per key. Extra aliases therefore require extra irreversibly destroyed value. Quote a minimum cost in a stable unit and adjust token quantity, so a token-price nadir does not make seats nearly free. This raises farming costs rather than proving unique people. Wealthy farms, reward subsidies and a dishonest price oracle remain weaknesses.
